settings.cross_group_partition: primary_10h first-window partition, held fixed for every scenario
settings.graph: simple undirected unit topology of qualifying recorded pairs

limits: The paper reports voluntary badge participation of about 75%; volunteer selection and missing contacts remain possible.
An identifier's zero records in a window do not establish attendance, eligibility, device uptime or lack of real contact.
Communities and group betweenness describe static aggregated recorded topology, not observed alliances, influence or temporal spreading paths.
The fixed baseline partition was optimized on the first window; later cross-partition differences are relative to that fitted partition, not a test of social integration.
A fixed Louvain seed ensures this execution is reproducible; community-solution uniqueness and robustness across algorithms or seeds are not established.
The reference group and node universe use the whole archive, including later records; this is not a past-only forecast or intervention evaluation.
Window and bin-threshold comparisons are descriptive sensitivity checks, not confidence intervals or an uncertainty model for missing sensors.

measurement.binary_topology: one undirected unit edge per pair meeting the declared bin threshold; bin totals are separate summaries
measurement.documented_local_origin: 2009-06-29 08:00, as paired with the source UNIX origin
measurement.duration_unit: recorded pair-bin seconds = 20 * retained pair-bin count; not independently measured continuous contact time
measurement.edge_absence_meaning: no pair satisfying the scenario's window and bin-count rule in the supplied artifact; not confirmed physical noncontact
measurement.node_universe: all identifiers appearing anywhere in the reviewed archive, retained in every graph, including zero-record nodes
measurement.source_interval_definition: the source documents each endpoint t as the contact bin [t-20,t]
measurement.window_rule: for aligned half-open [start,end) bin-start windows, include records with start < t <= end
measurement.zero_degree_meaning: zero qualifying records in this graph, not established social isolation or absence

qualification.scope: retrospective descriptive comparison of the reviewed published-record graphs

research_question: How do recorded cross-community contacts, static reachability and the same retrospective reference group differ between two equal observation windows?
